planets.name: HATS-72 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HATS-72 with a 7.33-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: HATS-72 b was found in 2020 by HATSouth as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HATS-72. Its orbit and size follow Hartman et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
